quote: On password change or "log out everywhere": revoke all of the user's sessions. Maintain a session registry to make this possible.
Without that check, a borrowed unlocked session becomes a permanent takeover. Afterwards, revoke the other sessions (rules/17 §2) and notify the user (below).
Expiry: idle timeout AND absolute timeout (e.g. 4–8h for a full-day office app) regardless of activity (CWE-613), both computed from **server-side timestamps**
